ownerThemes.theme: Owners who have used both say the Juki is sturdier than the Brother 1034D and easier to service yourself, at a higher price.
Threading is described as a little challenging for new sewers, offset by the front panel that opens for looper access.
Compared with the MO-644D, the 654DE moves the differential and length dials outside the door and handles thicker layers.

crossShop.why: The cheaper 3/4-thread alternative; buyers weigh build and 2-thread capability against about $100 to $200 in savings.
Same brand with air looper threading and an automatic needle threader at roughly three times the price.
Another 2/3/4-thread, 1,500 spm manual-threading serger, sold through dealers.

editorial.verdict: The MO-654DE is the step-up serger: 2/3/4 thread, 1,500 spm and a Juki 5-year mechanical warranty for a few hundred dollars.
editorial.whoFor: A sewist who wants 2-thread stitches and a heavier machine than the Brother 1034D without paying for air threading.
editorial.skipIf: You need a free arm, or you want the loopers threaded for you.
strengths: 2-thread overcast and rolled hem in addition to 3 and 4-thread stitches.
1,500 spm, faster than the 1,300 spm Brother and Singer entries.
Differential feed and stitch length dials sit outside the machine on the right side.
weaknesses: Juki's page does not publish weight, dimensions, stitch width or needle system in the results captured.
Price varies by dealer; two listings at the same retailer differed by about $100.

checks.title: Base machine or bonus bundle
checks.body: Many listings add feet kits, cones and needles. The Juki box lists a multipurpose foot, a spare lower knife and four spool caps. Price the base unit first.

checks.title: Manual lay-in threading
checks.body: Color-coded guides and a front door that opens. No air threading. If that is a dealbreaker, the MO-1000 is the same brand with jet air.

checks.title: Warranty seller
checks.body: Dealer copy quotes 5 years mechanical, 2 years electrical, 90 days labor. Confirm the seller is an authorized Juki dealer so the warranty applies.
